meta.name: Valor
meta.description:
The boundaries between military discipline and human desire are tested on a U.S. Army base that houses an elite unit of helicopter pilots trained to perform clandestine international and domestic missions. The drama unfolds in the present as well as in flashbacks to a failed mission involving one of the first female pilots in the unit, ultimately uncovering layers of personal and government/military secrets and leading to a season-long plan to rescue a group of MIA soldiers.

Rated TV-14 · Canceled · First aired 9 Oct 2017 · United States of America · Language: English · 43 min
Studio: CBS Studios · Network: The CW

Complete series. On your server: S1 13/13

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When a top-secret mission in Somalia goes awry, only Nora and Gallo return to the states; it's discovered that their missing teammate Jimmy is being held captive by terrorists; Nora and Gallo are determined to rescue him.

videos.title: Espirit de Corps
videos.overview: Nora and Gallo, with the secret still hanging over them, seek further information on the escaped prisoner from Somalia and perform a demo mission for Ian’s mother, who is a public figure with great power. Meanwhile, Jess struggles to work through her feelings.

videos.title: Soldier Ready
videos.overview: Nora starts relying more and more on vices to help calm her nerves, while searching for the truth about what happened in Somalia. Meanwhile, Ian and CIA officer Thea work together to figure out the next step in the rescue mission.

videos.title: Zero Visibility
videos.overview: While the Shadow Raiders prepare for the next step in their mission, Nora struggles to get her demons under control. CIA Officer Thea becomes increasingly more involved with the mission, creating even more tension in the group. Meanwhile, Gallo realizes that his relationship with Anna might be putting her in jeopardy.

videos.title: Full Battle Rattle
videos.overview: While the team scrambles for a new plan, Gallo puts himself in danger for the sake of the mission. Nora makes a decision that surprises and angers Gallo. Meanwhile, Ian clashes with CIA Deputy Director Magnus. Lastly, Thea realizes she has a lot to prove.

videos.title: I Got Your Six
videos.overview: While Nora prepares to prove herself to Gallo, she also considers confessing the truth to Ian. Jimmy and Crank’s actions have devastating consequences. Meanwhile, a frustrated Jess considers taking matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Blurred Lines
videos.overview: The Shadow Raiders finally get a lead; Nora makes a shocking discovery and must make a difficult decision; Gallo becomes distraught after receiving bad news; Jess feels more alone than ever.

videos.title: About-Face
videos.overview: Nora and Ian reach a critical point in their relationship. Gallo finds himself wrestling with PTSD. Meanwhile, Jess is forced to make a difficult choice.

videos.title: Stay Frosty
videos.overview: The Shadow Raiders are sent out on a mission which, if successful, could mean a dire outcome for Nora and Gallo. Meanwhile, Jimmy makes a choice that could result in big consequences for both he and Jess.

videos.title: Ciphers
videos.overview: Gallo and Thea join forces to try to decode an important message. Feeling disappointed, Col. Haskins considers making a big change.

videos.title: Command & Control
videos.overview: When Col. Haskins chooses Nora’s plan over Gallo’s, the tension between them reaches a boiling point.

videos.title: Oscar Mike
videos.overview: The Shadow Raiders are sent on the mission they’ve been waiting for. Nora and Gallo get separated from their crew and find themselves in a precarious situation. Trapped, everyone fears for their safety.

videos.title: Costs of War
videos.overview: Season Finale. Nora is ready to confess despite the consequences. Meanwhile, Ian is blindsided by an evil truth.

meta.slogan: Truth is the first casualty of war.
